add.title: AHAIC 2027: Africa Health Agenda International Conference (early-bird registration)
add.org: Amref Health Africa, with Rwanda's Ministry of Health, WHO Africa and Africa CDC
add.eligibility: Open to health professionals, researchers, policymakers and young people. Hybrid event in Kigali, 28 Feb to 3 Mar 2027, with a pillar on innovation, data and AI for health.

add.title: Commonwealth Shared Scholarships 2027/28 (including health data science and AI for medicine master's)
add.org: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK
add.eligibility: Citizens of eligible Commonwealth countries with a strong first degree who could not otherwise afford UK study. Eligible courses include health data science and AI for medicine master's at Bristol, St Andrews and Stirling.

add.title: Call for papers: digital health for health systems and universal health coverage in low- and middle-income countries
add.eligibility: Open to researchers worldwide working on mobile health, AI, telemedicine and health data systems in low- and middle-income countries. A publishing fee applies to accepted articles.

add.title: MIE 2027 call for workshops, panels, tutorials and demos (Tallinn, 26 to 30 April 2027)
add.eligibility: Open to health informatics researchers and practitioners worldwide. The paper and poster deadline has passed.

add.title: Call for papers: national eHealth strategies and the rules for sharing health data
add.eligibility: Open to researchers worldwide, with work from low- and middle-income countries especially welcome, on interoperability, data governance and eHealth policy. A publishing fee applies.

add.title: JMIR mHealth and uHealth theme issue: meaningful engagement with mobile health
add.eligibility: Open to researchers worldwide submitting research, reviews or viewpoints on engagement with mobile health. Standard open-access fees apply.

add.title: Digital Health: Planning National Systems (free self-paced course)
add.eligibility: Mainly for ministry of health officials and national planners, and open to other digital health practitioners. Available in English, French and Portuguese.

add.title: Consultant: digital family planning register, Uganda
add.eligibility: Consultants based in Kampala with digital health and DHIS2 experience, to bring private-sector family planning data into the national health information system. Applications are reviewed as they arrive.
